court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Additional District Judge (Fast Track Court No.1) at Salem - O.S.No.56 of 2004

parties.respondent_defendant: K.Mathivanam, Fathimabibi, Vijaya, Sannasi, Mathialagan, Arivazhagan, Mosili Veeran, Kasi, M.Venkatesan, G.Baskaran, Peter

facts_of_case: The defendants in a suit for partition are the appellants before this Court. They seek to challenge the judgement and decree of the Additional District Judge (Fast Track Court No.1) at Salem in O.S.No.56 of 2004.

legal_principles.principle: A father can make provision of property for an illegitimate son.
legal_principles.held: Under Ex.A.9, legal notice issued by the 5th defendant to other members of the family, the plaintiff is described as the son of Kandasamy Moopanar.
cited_cases: Raghuvir Kumar (minor) and others Vs. Smt. Shanmughavadivu and others, (1969) SCC Online Mad 234

legal_principles.principle: Recognition of a person as a family member by defendants can be evidence of their relationship.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff is described as the son of Kandasamy Moopanar in Ex.A.9, and the 1st and 5th defendants' active participation in the plaintiff's marriage photo (Ex.B.11) shows their acceptance of the plaintiff as a family member.
cited_cases: Raghuvir Kumar (minor) and others Vs. Smt. Shanmughavadivu and others, (1969) SCC Online Mad 234

legal_principles.principle: The succession of property is governed by the provisions of Section 8 of the Hindu Succession Act, not Section 6.
legal_principles.held: After the partition under Ex.A.1, the property which fell to the share of Kandasamy Moopanar has to be treated as his separate properties.
cited_cases: Rohit Chauhann Vs. Surinder Singh and others, (2013) 9 SCC page 419

legal_principles.principle: The fact that a person professes the Hindu religion is relevant in determining their rights under Hindu law.
legal_principles.held: The plaintiff who had done the obsequies of his father and is professing the Hindu religion is evident from Ex.A.1, A.2 and B.6.

outcome.final_order: The defendants' appeal is allowed, and the judgement and decree made in O.S.No.56 of 2004 are set aside.

use_for_drafting: advising on Hindu Marriage Act and Hindu Succession Act
